items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I play his tune all the time. I just played it the other night. Dat Dere. We played that, recorded it.

ctx.x: That’s probably why I did it, because of him. He probably got me engaged in that.
Then continuing – so, no recollection about Bobby? Because Bobby’s so funky. He was straight out of the church.
I play his tune all the time. I just played it the other night. Dat Dere. We played that, recorded it. We played it the other night.
